items.title: U.S. budget deficit surged in July to highest level since March 2021
items.summary: Beyond the big single-month jump, the collective red ink over the 10 months of the fiscal year rose to nearly $1.8 trillion, surpassing the same period in 2025.

items.title: 'Nobody wants it': Lettuce prices see record-setting plunge as cyclospora spooks consumers
items.summary: Lettuce prices posted their sharpest month-over-month decline on record as diners reconsider the vegetable amid the cyclospora outbreak.

items.title: Here are five key takeaways from the July CPI inflation report
items.summary: Readings for July on the prices consumers pay for goods and services came in pretty much on target.

items.title: Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July, as expected, putting the annual rate at 3.4%
items.summary: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.1% in July, with an annual rate of 3.4%.

items.title: SpaceX short sellers are running out of bullets as stock rebounds more than 40% off low
items.summary: Short interest in SpaceX fell to about 11% of the company's publicly traded shares Wednesday, down sharply from a peak of 34% last week, according to S3.

items.title: Woman claims her stepfather used Grok to transform childhood photo into explicit imagery
items.summary: The woman claimed that AI tools are "taking everyday life and turning it into child sexual abuse."
